simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָדִיד (H7289) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רָדִיד (râdîyd) means a veil (as expanded) First listed occurrence: Isa 3 23.

definitions.full: H7289. radid [ רְדִיד ] noun [masculine] wide wrapper, or large veil ( ᵑ7 Jer רְדִידָא (especially for Hebrew צָעִיף ); Syriac apparently veil ; Arabic is wrapper ); — suffix רְדִידִי Song 5:7 ; plural דָרְדִידִים Isa 3:23 (in list of women's finery).
definitions.rootNote: from 7286 in the sense of spreading ;
